Download **scorm-kit-skill.zip** to add the skill to:

- **claude.ai**: *Customize → Skills → Add → Upload skill*
- **ChatGPT**: *Customize → Skills → Add → Upload from your computer*, then use it in **Work** mode

Claude Code and Codex install from the repo directly. See the [README](https://github.com/A79-ai/scorm-kit#install).
